from datetime import datetime

# Ensure simple_note access token
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
pass_map = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in creds}
login_resp = apis.simple_note.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=pass_map['simple_note'])
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
print('simple_note logged in:', bool(access_token))

query = 'workout plan'
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_notes = []

while True:
    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
    # resp is expected list of notes
    if not resp:
        break
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
    # Print brief info
    print([(n['note_id'], n['title'], n.get('tags'), n.get('pinned')) for n in resp])
    all_notes.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

print('Total matched notes for query:', query, '=>', len(all_notes))
# Post-filter by title containing 'workout' and 'plan'
filtered = [n for n in all_notes if n.get('title') and 'workout' in n['title'].lower() and 'plan' in n['title'].lower()]
print('After title filter =>', len(filtered))
print([(n['note_id'], n['title']) for n in filtered])
